name: mcp
description: Bridge external MCP servers' tools into the catalog as ordinary operations — curated one-by-one or mirrored wholesale. Load to connect outside tool servers.

content.inline:
## MCP bridging
Bridged tools become ORDINARY catalog operations — capability grants, job records and schema validation all apply. The tool is the entity; the server is just where it lives.

- add-tool `{server, tool, path, auth?, name?, description?, default?}` — curate ONE remote tool at a catalog path you choose (e.g. `o/research/search_papers`). `default` pre-fills arguments to purpose-shape it (a generic 5-field create_issue becomes a 2-field report_bug). Remove with covia delete on the path.
- add-server `{name, url, auth?, scope?}` — mirror ALL of a server's tools under `o/mcp/<name>/` (venue scope needs the mcp/manage capability). remove-server takes it away.
- refresh `{name}` reconciles a mirror (vanished tools deleted); refresh `{path}` updates a curated tool in place (your name/description kept; vanished reported, never deleted).
- tools-list `{server, auth?}` previews a server's tools before bridging.

Rules:
- `auth` must be a secret ref (`s/<name>`) — raw tokens warn and should be re-stored.
- Server URLs pass the venue's SSRF/allowlist checks.
- Once bridged, call the op like any other. If an offered tool NAME does not match what you expect, you can always call an op by its full catalog path or asset ref as the tool name — dispatch resolves references directly (capability-gated as usual).
